source_spans.exact_text:  If the engine does not start. Do not hold the starter switch in depressed condition for long periods, this will cause the battery to drain below the threshold level of 10 V. Please get the motorcycle checked through an Royal Enfield Authorised Service Centre to identify and correct the reason for not starting.

server_required_source_display.text: Do not keep holding the starter for long periods: this can drain the battery below 10 V. An unresolved no-start condition requires authorised-service inspection.

source_spans.exact_text:  To shift into neutral, move the motorcycle back and forth gently, while simultaneously shifting the gear. Ensure gear is in neutral position and the neutral lamp is glowing in the instrument cluster.
 Turn ignition key to ON position and engine kill switch on right hand side handle bar to run position.
 Check the fuel level indicator in the cluster for adequate fuel in the fuel tank. In case the last bar is blinking continuously, it indicates low fuel level in the tank. Please re-fuel immediately.
 Disengage clutch by pulling in the clutch lever and hold it in depressed condition.

 Vehicle may start with side stand condition but engine will turn-off when gear is engaged, this side stand cutoff feature is provided for rider safety ensure side stand is retracted before vehicle moving / starting.

server_required_source_display.text: Before an actual starting attempt, establish neutral and neutral lamp glowing, ignition ON, right-hand kill switch RUN, adequate fuel/no continuously blinking final bar, clutch pulled in and held, and side stand fully retracted.

source_spans.exact_text:  Do not press the starter button more than 5 seconds after three successive cranking, wait for 15 to 20 seconds the battery to recover.

server_required_source_display.text: If you have already made three successive cranking attempts, wait 15–20 seconds for the battery to recover.

source_spans.exact_text: Please get the electrical system of your motorcycle checked thoroughly and get the faults corrected immediately after experiencing any fuse failure. Failure to do so may result in repeated fuse failure.

server_required_source_display.text: After any fuse failure, have the electrical system thoroughly checked and faults corrected immediately at authorised service, even if replacement restores operation.

source_spans.exact_text: Any attempt to jumper a defective fuse gives rise to the risk of a short-circuit and fire. Always replace a defective fuse with a new fuse of the same rating.
Usage of fuses other than specified rating or usage of any other conductive materials or low grade fuses will damage the complete electrical system.

server_required_source_display.text: Never bridge a defective fuse or substitute conductive material; this risks short-circuit and fire. Wrong-rating or low-grade fuses can damage the electrical system.
Any fuse failure requires electrical-system inspection and correction; otherwise failures may repeat.
An unspecified fuse rating, conductive substitute or low-quality fuse can damage the complete electrical system.
The manual requires spare-fuse replenishment at the earliest opportunity.
Jumpering a defective fuse risks short circuit and fire; a replacement must retain the specified rating.
Replacement of bulbs, fuses or electrical parts requires ignition OFF.

source_spans.exact_text:  Over filling may result in gasoline entering the EVAP canister and may damage the evaporative emission system.

server_required_source_display.text: Overfilling can send gasoline into the EVAP canister and damage the emission system.
The stated fuel values are approximate; actual filling capacity varies.
Do not use the motorcycle for long with the last fuel-indicator segment blinking; refuel at the earliest.
